usedFor: Cin7 Core holds orders and stock, and Google Drive shares a file after “When a purchase order is authorised”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a purchase order is authorised” in Cin7 Core, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Authorisation is a clear checkpoint on a purchase order, so the file gets shared once it is settled.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” opens a file by link, so choose Viewer unless people need to edit.
